replies.author: BattleOfEmber
replies.body: Thanks, I mostly use assets for those when I made that trailer, which I now noticed that those are too expensive and cost lots of render issue now. I would suggest clean up the asset files as early as possible, use mesh instance as many as possible.

comments.author: kurkul
comments.body: I believe AI cutscenes in 2026 are a drawback, because they are the same thing as pre-rendered cutscenes in older games. In modern games, cutscenes seamlessly transition into gameplay, which looks way more impressive and immersive rather than cutting to a black screen. Of course, this type of cutscene has its own place. But in my opinion, it would look 'cheaper,' especially knowing players' opinions on AI. Again, if we talk about mobile games, it's a different story, kids will click on all shiny things.
